subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Consictent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Consictent"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Consistent"**. (संगत/स्थिर)

 
 
• **Incorrect Word Meaning:** The word "Consictent" has no meaning as it is a misspelling.
 
 
 
• **Correct Word:** The word "Consistent" means acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate. (संगत/स्थिर)
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance has been consistent throughout the year.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trifle** (तुच्छ): A thing of little value or importance.

 
 
• **Example:** He dismissed the problem as a mere trifle.
 
 
 
• **Surrender** (आत्मसमर्पण): To give up or hand over something, especially in a situation where one is overpowered.
 
 
• **Example:** The enemy was forced to surrender after a prolonged battle.
 
 
 
• **Disgust** (घृणा): A strong feeling of dislike or disapproval.
 
 
• **Example:** She expressed her disgust at the unfair treatment of workers.
